description: The contracting parties are Collectible Concepts Group, Inc. and Pivotal Self Service Tech, Inc., who are forming a joint venture named MightyCell Batteries to engage in business as outlined in the agreement.
The contracting parties are Stremick Heritage Foods, LLC and Premier Nutrition Corporation, and the core commercial purpose of the contract is a manufacturing agreement.

The contracting parties are Natalija Tunevic, director of FreeCook, and Mitchell Vitalis, director of Mitchell's Web Advance, PLC, for the purpose of designing and developing a website for the Client.

The Trademark License Agreement is between Morgan Stanley Investment Management Inc. as Licensor and Morgan Stanley Direct Lending Fund as Licensee, allowing the Licensee to use the "Morgan Stanley" brand for specified investment advisory activities.
The Gas Transportation Agreement is made between PennTex North Louisiana Operating, LLC as the Transporter and MRD Operating LLC as the Customer for the purpose of gas transportation services.
